summary: BRAT data.json top-level shape is pluginList, pluginSubListFrozenVersion, themesList, scalar booleans/string settings, plus deprecated token fields.
pluginSubListFrozenVersion stores repo plus version ('latest' or tag/string), optional tokenName, optional deprecated token, and optional isIncompatible; pluginList remains the repo membership list.
themesList entries store repo and lastUpdate checksum; theme updates are based on theme CSS checksum rather than manifest version.
Plugin validation and install are release-asset-first: selected GitHub release assets provide manifest.json, main.js, and optional styles.css; valid id/version are required.
Specific versions use the releases/tags API endpoint; latest uses releases list sorted by semver when possible, with publish-date fallback, and prerelease inclusion controlled by the caller.
Install writes main.js, manifest.json, and optional styles.css under .obsidian/plugins/{manifest.id}; enableAfterInstall loads the manifest and calls enablePluginAndSave.
Pinned versions are skipped during update cycles when version is neither empty nor latest; docs confirm frozen installs do not update with other plugins.
Theme install prefers theme-beta.css over theme.css, writes theme.css plus manifest.json into the themes folder, switches current theme, and tracks CSS changes by checksum.
